description: An i18n locale-parity standard. Static checks verify `SUPPORTED_LOCALES`, a typed `strings.ts`, locale-key parity across locales, and `vrooli.locale` persistence. Runtime checks verify `<html lang>`/`dir` are set. Auto-fix can scaffold missing locale keys and add lang/dir (safe fixers).

requirements.description: Static i18n checks must verify presence of a `SUPPORTED_LOCALES` declaration, a typed `strings.ts`, locale-key parity across all supported locales, and `vrooli.locale` persistence wiring. Missing keys or non-parity across locales must produce Findings.
requirements.title: Static i18n checks

validation.notes: Absence of SUPPORTED_LOCALES or a typed strings.ts produces a Finding
A key present in one locale but missing in another produces a locale-key-parity Finding
Missing vrooli.locale persistence wiring produces a Finding
Run ui-health against a scenario with a missing locale key and confirm the parity Finding is emitted
The i18n static standard enforces locale parity and typed strings across scenarios

requirements.description: Runtime i18n checks must verify the rendered document sets `<html lang>` and `dir`. Safe auto-fixers must be able to scaffold missing locale keys and add the lang/dir attributes.
requirements.title: Runtime lang/dir + safe scaffolding fixers

validation.notes: Missing <html lang> or dir at runtime produces a runtime i18n Finding
The locale-key scaffolding fixer adds missing keys and is idempotent
The lang/dir fixer inserts the attributes safely without altering other markup
Run the i18n fixers and confirm missing locale keys are scaffolded and lang/dir are added on re-validate
Runtime lang/dir and safe i18n scaffolding round out the locale-parity standard

title: i18n locale-parity standard
